Browse by menu

  • Game Settings: base Among Us rules such as maps, meetings, movement, and tasks.
  • System Settings: room controls, protections, display, and other global mod behavior.
  • Mod Settings: mode, assignment, map, meeting, task, and sabotage rules.
  • Add-on Settings: Add-on display and assignment limits.
  • Impostor Settings: Impostor and Madmate information and interactions.
  • Neutral Settings: Neutral counts and faction win-together rules.

Current TOHEE places role options under pages such as Impostor Roles, Crewmate Roles, and Neutral Roles. Items nested under a role name are specific to that role, not general role documentation. The menu hides options that do not apply to the selected mode; see game modes.

About the upstream settings pages

Most of the eight old upstream options/Settings pages are role-directory HTML, not separate settings pages. This section extracts only the parts that contain general settings. The old Coven page listed global Coven quotas, venting, and vision controls that are not present in current TOHEE settings tabs; the Crewmate page has no separate general settings section. Do not treat old role lists or options as current client behavior.

Names and ranges change between mod versions. Use the settings menu in the current game and the current release notes as the source of truth; these pages explain the purpose of groups rather than replace the in-game options.
